1.original: Deliver the requested materials to Kageel Ja.

48.original: Sorry, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I need you to make a trip to the upper forest. Are you up for it?

49.original: Our gainery is the new face of Mamook, so I'd like it to be tidy and well-kept for all who come to visit.

50.original: With that said, I'd be grateful if you collected some Ut'ohmu natron from the vicinity of Iq Br'aax. It can be used as a cleaning agent.

51.original: With that said, I'd be grateful if you collected some concentrated Ut'ohmu plant oil from the vicinity of Iq Br'aax. It can be used as a cleaning agent.

52.original: With that said, I'd be grateful if you collected an Ut'ohmu trout from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly. We can extract a decent polishing agent from it.

53.original: Be sure to use golden stonefly nymphs as bait. We have some for sale here, in case you weren't aware.

54.original: I would be grateful if you collected some Ut'ohmu natron from around Iq Br'aax. We'll need it as a cleaning agent.

55.original: I would be grateful if you collected some concentrated Ut'ohmu plant oil from around Iq Br'aax. We'll need it as a cleaning agent.

56.original: I would be grateful if you caught an Ut'ohmu trout from Xd'aa Talat Tsoly. We can extract a decent polishing agent from it.

57.original: Be sure to bait your line with golden stonefly nymphs.

59.original: Perfect, exactly what I requested. Thank you.

60.original: You may have noticed during your venture, but the Xbr'aal people also use such cleaning agents in their daily lives.

61.original: The upper forest is far more exposed to the elements, which requires greater structural maintenance and upkeep.

62.original: So when I noticed our buildings needed some brushing up, I consulted our Xbr'aal neighbors. They were good enough to recommend some materials, and invited us to gather as much as we needed. If it's to keep this place presentable, I may well take them up on that offer again...
